status: Read-only source analysis; no counter reply or implementation added.

firmware_consumer.source_revision: 64680f8a4da0b9a3b532051f0aa18429fcf04e82; exact bm1397.c bytes match retained002. Matching source/version does not independently establish a factory rebuild.
firmware_consumer.read04: REGISTER_HASHRATE calls update_hashrate. This is a rate value, not the cumulative counter path. Bit31 must be clear and low31 bits must not equal0x007fffff, otherwise the previous displayed measurement is retained.
firmware_consumer.rate_scaling: Literal HASHRATE_UNIT=0x100000 =2^20. GH/s=value*1048576/1e9. The comment incorrectly says2^24 and is not used as executable semantics.
firmware_consumer.rate_interval: The consumer polls each1000ms but does not pass elapsed time to update_hashrate. This does not establish the ASIC measurement window, latch or read-clear policy.
firmware_consumer.read4c: REGISTER_ERROR_COUNT calls update_hash_counter. It subtracts prior uint32 values with wraparound, ignores intervals<1000000us, and calls hashCounterToGhs. That helper scales each count by2^32 hashes and divides by elapsed seconds. A CRC error, pool rejection or software error must not be substituted for a silicon nonce-error count.
firmware_consumer.reply_endian: BM1397 command result value is converted with ntohl; serial response representation must remain consistent with existing independent reply vectors.

supporting_reference_limits.hash_rate_rs: ADDR04 implemented. LONG31 and7fffffff masks are comments only, with no measurement algorithm.
supporting_reference_limits.bm1397_constructor: Seeds0x80000000 as reference-project state. This is not measured physical reset evidence.
supporting_reference_limits.nonce_counter_rs: ADDR4c and50 implemented, but field masks are comments and error/overflow event definitions are absent.

low_rate_consequence.explanation: A one-second computed-work measurement at or below the functional cap cannot produce one raw rate unit. A zero must be derived from measured completed work under an explicit model policy; it must not be returned merely to bypass the read. Production-rate self-test acceptance will require its own recorded firmware adaptation or remain failed.

proposal_not_implemented.default: Keep exact/default counter capability unknown and unsupported.
proposal_not_implemented.reference_policy: Add a separately identified measurement policy with explicit window, quantization, initial state, reset, rollover, latch and read semantics; bind it in run identity/adaptation. Physical semantics are not inferred.
proposal_not_implemented.work_source: Only completed per-chip SHA-256d computations from actual hardware-submitted jobs can advance measurement state. Never use requested PLL frequency, cap*elapsed or synthetic performance events.
proposal_not_implemented.before_jobs: The policy may report zero only with evidence that its actual computation ledger is empty. The initial039 call has no accepted job or completed hash. This is an explicit reference-model adaptation, not an exact ASIC reset claim.
proposal_not_implemented.errors: Do not invent a4c mapping. Define any reference error policy separately, based on actual injected/observed computation faults and their counted unit; physical error-counter behavior stays unresolved.
proposal_not_implemented.next_actual_test: After018/040 clock observation, execute a separate reference measurement capability if reviewed. Preserve any high-rate factory self-test failure, then inspect its exact executable thresholds before a minimal low-rate firmware adaptation.
